title: Brand reveal
description: A logo settles into an app tile, the tile rises, and the brand name and tagline rise in with motion blur. 4 s, silent, 16:9.

slots.name: logo
slots.note: A square logo from the library (transparent PNG is best), as an asset name; null draws a four-petal mark in the accent colour.

slots.name: name
slots.note: The brand or product name, 3-12 characters.

slots.name: tagline
slots.note: One short line, at most 40 characters.

slots.name: background
slots.note: The field behind the lockup; dark works best.

slots.name: accent
slots.note: The drawn mark's colour (unused with a logo).

beats.say: The mark settles into its tile.
The tile rises; the name and tagline rise in.
beats.label: Name and tagline
